name: fld_sum_quadraticChar_sq_add
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∑ x : ZMod p, quadraticChar (ZMod p) (x ^ 2 + a) = -1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0), ∑ x : ZMod p, quadraticChar (ZMod p) (x ^ 2 + a) = -1
informal: Quadratic character sum Σ_x χ(x^2 + a) = -1 for a ≠ 0 in F_p, p odd — count solutions of y^2 = x^2 + a two ways: it equals Σ_x (1 + χ(x^2 + a)) by quadraticChar_card_sqrts and equals p - 1 by the hyperbola count (y-x)(y+x) = a.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → ∀ (a : ZMod p), a ≠ 0 → ∑ x, (quadraticChar (ZMod p)) (x ^ 2 + a) = -1
